{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOQ7BKhc8AAAABXFX3dg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm6sGzhApIVg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm6sG", "number": 9, "title": "Implement Draft v2.0 in loader and exporter, remove v1.0 support, and add tests", "body": "## Problem

The loader and exporter reference plugins still target the Draft v1.0 encoding, while the root specification is now **Draft v2.0**. Update both existing plugins to implement v2.0 completely, with **no v1.0 backward compatibility**. Remove obsolete v1.0-specific code and options rather than carrying a dual-version compatibility layer.

## Expected outcome

### Loader plugin
- Accept only `THREE_materials_tsl` v2.0; validate required `version`, non-empty `materialType`, `entrypoints`, and `nodes`.
- Resolve each material's `materialType` to a supported Three.js NodeMaterial class, with a consumer-extensible mapping for custom types; do not silently substitute a different type.
- Preserve ordinary material properties from the glTF core and other supported non-TSL material extensions, and apply the TSL graph in addition. Preserve dynamic references such as `materialColor` -> `material.color`.
- Ensure full-material fallback to the original ordinary glTF material, including other supported extensions, on any v2.0 validation/type/graph failure. No partial TSL mutations or replacement materials may survive failure.
- Handle shared materials, mesh-specific clones, and coexistence with other glTF material extensions as supported by Three.js.

### Exporter plugin
- Emit only `version: "2.0"`, with the required `materialType` taken from the actual NodeMaterial type; reject invalid/missing types.
- Preserve and export ordinary material properties via glTF core and supported non-TSL material extensions, while serializing TSL entrypoints/nodes/links separately.
- Ensure the exported ordinary material fallback is usable without TSL support. Do not silently drop properties/links essential to the claimed supported cases.
- Retain `three.revision` as optional informational metadata only; do not add revision-based migration logic.

### Remove v1.0 support
- Remove v1.0 defaults, version compatibility branches, and obsolete loader/exporter options or code paths whose only purpose is supporting v1.0.
- Keep the codebase clean and v2.0-only. Update package docs, examples/demo, and package versions as appropriate. No backward-compatibility promise is required.

## Tests

The repository currently has TypeScript build scripts but no automated test suite. Add and run automated tests covering at least:
- v2.0 export/load of MeshStandardNodeMaterial and MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial, including correct per-material type resolution.
- Ordinary material values plus TSL nodes, especially a dynamic `materialColor` reference after changing `material.color`.
- Core PBR values and representative supported `KHR_materials_*` properties, including clearcoat/transmission where supported.
- Shared materials and loader-created clones.
- Missing/invalid/unknown `materialType`, unsupported version, broken node/link references, cycles, and unknown `op`: whole-extension fallback with no partial application.
- Export → import → export → import round trips: preserve supported ordinary properties, node graph structure and runtime behavior.
- v1.0 data is **not** interpreted as v2.0 and falls back normally; do not add v1.0-specific reconstruction logic.

## Scope and acceptance
- [ ] Both existing plugins implement the root README Draft v2.0 requirements.
- [ ] Remove v1.0 support and obsolete compatibility code entirely.
- [ ] Document the supported Three.js/node/material scope and any limitations rather than claiming universal node support.
- [ ] Automated tests exist and pass, and loader/exporter/demo builds pass.
- [ ] Verify standard glTF fallback and interoperability with other supported material extensions.
- [ ] No changes to the normative v2.0 specification unless a genuine specification defect is discovered and separately discussed.

## Context

- [Draft v2.0 specification](https://github.com/takahirox/THREE_materials_tsl/blob/main/README.md)
- [Loader plugin](https://github.com/takahirox/THREE_materials_tsl/blob/main/packages/loader/src/THREEMaterialsTSLLoaderPlugin.ts)
- [Exporter plugin](https://github.com/takahirox/THREE_materials_tsl/blob/main/packages/exporter/src/THREEMaterialsTSLExporterPlugin.ts)
- Related specification issue: #7 / PR #8.

## Pre-merge validation
Run all new tests, package TypeScript builds, demo build, and `git diff --check`. Record results and any remaining scope limitations in the PR.

## Required post-merge verification
